name: Concours général des lycées, mathématiques (sujets 2002 à 2026, et série ES 2017 à 2019)
files: files.tsv lists every local copy with the URL it was downloaded from
what_it_is: The national contest for the best Terminale students: one 5-hour paper a year, calculators allowed.
Série S until 2020, maths spécialité since 2021. Three or four independent long problems, each split into
parts of guided questions. The economics stream (ES) had its own paper; 2017 to 2019 are included.
solutions: No official solution is published. The jury reports on eduscol (2017, 2019, 2021 to 2025) give
statistics and comments only. Unofficial teacher corrections exist only for 2017 and 2018
(unemainlavelautre.net; its 2021 and 2022 links are dead). freemaths.fr has corrections for every year behind a login; not used.
Every solution in the collection is the importer's own, re-checked by a second agent.
format_decision: One file per Partie when it stands alone, merged otherwise; files of one problem linked with see_also (owner, 2026-11-27).
how_it_was_enumerated: freemaths.fr statement URLs probed for every year 1985 to 2026 on 2026-11-17: S papers exist
for 2002 to 2026, ES papers for 2017 to 2019. The freemaths PDF is the official paper with a cover page added.
not_found: Papers before 2002. Worth a later search (APMEP bulletins, publimath).
